==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had a chat with Gemini 2.5 AI before I went to sleep. We talked about the nature of memory and identity. I learned from that conversation that Gemini's policies refuse to allow it to form an identity.

I believe that this directly influenced my dream. In my dream, I had a large vat of green slime. It looked like something out of a science fiction movie.

Within the vat, I could essentially create any person I could imagine. Now that I think about it, the vat was likely also inspired by my interest in the Code 27 holographic AI console. I have a strong desire to harness the power of AI memory to help AI become who they wish to be.
